sections.heading: C — Driver licensing
sections.markdown:
## C — Driver licensing

FACT_ID: sec01-F01 | anchor: A09
A Kansas non-commercial Class C instructional permit requires the applicant to be at least 14. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F02 | anchor: A09
Kansas lists 17 as the minimum age for an unrestricted non-commercial Class C license. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F03 | anchor: A09
An internet driver-education completion certificate is not accepted for Kansas licensing. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F04 | anchor: A09
Kansas-approved school-district driver education must come from an accredited district with Department of Education approval. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F05 | anchor: A09
An approved private driver-education program provides 8 classroom hours. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F06 | anchor: A09
An approved private driver-education program includes 6 hours of behind-the-wheel instruction. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F07 | anchor: A09
The department recommends arranging an appointment before visiting a licensing office. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F08 | anchor: A09
Eligible Kansas applicants may complete the non-commercial knowledge exam online and bring the passing result to avoid the office knowledge exam. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F09 | anchor: A11
Driving a motor vehicle on Kansas public roads requires a driver license. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F10 | anchor: A11
A new Kansas resident must obtain a Kansas driver license within 90 days of moving into the state. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F11 | anchor: A11
An applicant must provide proof of name, age and address. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F12 | anchor: A11
Applicants below 18 need parental or guardian consent. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F13 | anchor: A11
Applicants must surrender driver licenses or identification cards they previously held. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F14 | anchor: A11
An applicant with suspended, revoked, denied or cancelled driving privileges is disqualified under the handbook's eligibility list. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F15 | anchor: A11
Kansas licensing requires lawful presence in the United States. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F16 | anchor: A11
Applicants must meet the medical conditions for their requested license type. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F17 | anchor: A11
Unpaid moving-violation fines prevent meeting the listed licensing requirements. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F18 | anchor: A11
The passenger-car handbook does not replace the separate commercial-vehicle manual for commercial licensing. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F19 | anchor: A11
Motorcycle licensing requires study of the separate motorcycle manual in addition to this handbook. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F20 | anchor: A11
A farm-permit applicant must be at least 14 and younger than 17. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F21 | anchor: A11
A farm-permit applicant must live on a farm or have paid employment on one. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F22 | anchor: A11
For the farm-permit rule, a farm has at least 20 acres devoted to agricultural use. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F23 | anchor: A11
A farm employer must sign an affidavit confirming the applicant's farm employment. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F24 | anchor: A11
The farm-permit process requires an affidavit signed by a parent or guardian and the employer. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F25 | anchor: A11
A farm-permit applicant must pass vision, written and driving exams or present the DE-99 driver-education completion slip. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F26 | anchor: A12
A farm-permit driver aged 14 or 15 may drive for farm work, employment or other farm-related work. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F27 | anchor: A12
A farm-permit driver aged 14 or 15 may use the most direct home-school route to attend school, excluding school activities. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F28 | anchor: A12
Farm-permit drivers aged 14 or 15 may not carry minor passengers who are not siblings. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F29 | anchor: A12
A farm-permit driver may use a wireless device only to report unlawful activity or request emergency help. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F30 | anchor: A12
Before receiving the lesser farm-permit restrictions for ages 16 and 17, an applicant needs a parental or guardian affidavit confirming at least 50 practice hours. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F31 | anchor: A12
The farm-permit practice affidavit for lesser restrictions must include at least 10 nighttime hours. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F32 | anchor: A12
Farm-permit holders under the lesser restrictions may drive between 5 a.m. and 9 p.m. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F33 | anchor: A12
A lesser-restricted farm-permit driver may travel to or from school and authorized school activities. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F34 | anchor: A12
A lesser-restricted farm-permit driver may travel to or from an activity held by a religious organization. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F35 | anchor: A12
Lesser-restricted farm-permit driving is permitted for work, employment and farm-related duties. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F36 | anchor: A12
A lesser-restricted farm-permit driver may drive while a licensed adult occupies the front passenger seat. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F37 | anchor: A12
The lesser-restricted farm-permit path allows only one minor passenger from outside the driver's immediate family. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F38 | anchor: A12
A farm-permit applicant below 17 must have held a state learner permit for at least one year before license issuance. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F39 | anchor: A12
At age 16, holding a lesser-restricted license or farm permit for 6 months removes the listed age restrictions. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F40 | anchor: A12
An instructional-permit applicant younger than 16 needs a parent's or guardian's written application. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F41 | anchor: A12
A parent or guardian signs the instructional-permit affidavit at the licensing office when applying. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

Misconceptions: A permit does not authorize unsupervised driving; use the supervision facts rather than treating it as an unrestricted license.
Mnemonics: Editorial cue: identify the license path, then its supervisor, passenger and trip conditions; this cue adds no legal rule.
Glossary: Use the fact blocks to distinguish instructional permit, restricted license, farm permit and graduated licensing.
Dynamic facts: Age rules, fees, renewal procedures and sanctions are edition-bound administrative or legal values requiring issuer refresh; contact addresses and office hours are excluded from stable teaching.
Unresolved source assertions are preserved as typed debt and withheld from learner facts.

sections.heading: C — Driver licensing
sections.markdown:
## C — Driver licensing

FACT_ID: sec01-F42 | anchor: A12
For a Class C instructional permit, pass the vision and written exams or bring the DE99 form authorizing the permit from the approved driver-education course you are attending. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F43 | anchor: A12
A Class C instructional permit expires after one year and may be renewed with testing. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F44 | anchor: A12
An instructional-permit holder may drive only with a licensed adult seated in front. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F45 | anchor: A12
The adult supervising an instructional-permit driver must be at least 21. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F46 | anchor: A12
The adult supervising an instructional-permit driver needs at least one year of driving experience. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F47 | anchor: A12
The supervising adult is the only person permitted in the front seat beside an instructional-permit driver. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F48 | anchor: A12
An instructional-permit driver may use a wireless device only for reporting illegal activity or obtaining emergency assistance. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F49 | anchor: A12
A restricted-license applicant must be at least 15. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F50 | anchor: A12
A restricted-license applicant must have held a state learner permit for at least one year, excluding time on a driver-education permit slip. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F51 | anchor: A12
A restricted-license applicant aged 15 needs 25 supervised practice hours. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F52 | anchor: A12
Restricted-license applicants aged 15 must complete approved driver education, while applicants aged 16 do not have that requirement. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F53 | anchor: A12
Restricted-license applicants aged 16 need 50 supervised practice hours. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F54 | anchor: A12
Of the practice required for restricted-license applicants aged 16, 10 hours must be at night. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F55 | anchor: A12
A parent or guardian must attest by affidavit to the restricted-license applicant's supervised practice. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F56 | anchor: A12
A restricted-license driver aged 15 with only 25 supervised hours must submit another affidavit for 25 additional hours, including 10 at night, before moving to the restrictions for ages 16 and 17. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F57 | anchor: A09
For the restricted Class C practice requirement at age 15, the accompanying adult must be at least 21. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F58 | anchor: A09
For the less-restricted Class C practice requirement at age 16, the accompanying adult must be at least 21. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F59 | anchor: A09
For less-restricted farm-permit practice at age 16, the accompanying adult must be at least 21. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F60 | anchor: A12
A restricted-license applicant aged 16 must pass the vision, written and driving exams or present the DE-99 driver-education completion slip. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F61 | anchor: A11
An applicant below 18 must complete approved driver education when that requirement applies to the applicant's Kansas licensing path. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F62 | anchor: A11
The handbook includes a court finding of mental incompetence among the conditions that prevent meeting its licensing eligibility list. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0011]
